accepted.evidence: Turner 4147 §2 assigns regional Punjabi gāu and gā̃ “cow” to feminine *gāvā-. Grierson Khetrani gāũ “Cow” matches this nasalized feminine branch; the first survey slot has its own persistent identity. Exact LSI digital-edition key and original spelling checked; no import or transcription change.
